reviews.title: QuadCast Boom Arm Mic Stand
reviews.comment: As a user of the HyperX QuadCast Solo microphone, the QuadCast Boom Arm Mic Stand has proven to be an invaluable addition to my setup. Here’s a concise review based on my experience: The stand boasts a sturdy build with a sleek black finish that complements any workspace. Its adjustable suspension boom scissor arm allows for precise positioning of the microphone, enhancing flexibility during recording sessions. Setting up the stand is straightforward with a strong desk clamp that securely holds without damaging surfaces. It’s easy to adjust the arm’s height and angle using smooth articulation and tension knobs, ensuring optimal microphone positioning. The QuadCast Boom Arm Mic Stand is a highly recommended accessory for enhancing recording setups. Its robust construction, ease of adjustment, and reliable performance make it ideal for podcasters, streamers, and professionals seeking quality audio solutions. I rate the QuadCast Boom Arm Mic Stand highly for its excellent design, ease of use, and solid performance, making it a worthwhile investment for improving microphone setup efficiency and audio quality.
reviews.author: Tomas Ruiz

reviews.title: Adhesive issues
reviews.comment: Range of motion is pretty good for the price. My only issue with it is that the rubber pad in the clamp has bad adhesive so it’s starting to shift/fall off. Besides that very good value & quality for your money.
reviews.author: BobbyFresh

reviews.title: Perfect mic arm!
reviews.comment: Great boom mic mount! Replaced the bad one on my hyperx. Works great and no issues! Very sturdy and endless adjustment.
reviews.author: John Mix

reviews.title: It does it's job, can be a little finnicky. Good starter
reviews.comment: Seems pretty sturdy, some movements are smooth while others are stiff, the little bit that physically screws into the mic is not on there very well and doesn't get very tight so I Have to unplug my mic and spin it a couple times to tighten it back up before I can set it to my ideal postition. If anything touches the mic after I have fixed it, it will become loose again and I have to repeat the process. if you are just getting into streaming, or just want to conserve some desk space then this is a good boom arm for getting started.
reviews.author: Coty T. Dawkins
